normalized.result: Yes, it should. To me " Reference " and "reference" are the same tag — the extra spaces and the capital letter are just typing noise. If the app made a separate tag for each variation, I'd end up with the same category split across several near-identical tags, which is exactly the mess I'm trying to avoid. So trimming the spaces and matching regardless of capitalization so it reuses the existing "reference" is what I'd want.
